hero.title: Smart Weather for Smarter Farming
hero.subtitle: Real-time weather insights designed for Indian farmers. Track rainfall, moisture indices, and irrigation advisories.

insights.title: Agricultural Advisories
insights.subtitle: Dynamic field guidelines computed from current weather parameters.
insights.sprayOk: Wind conditions are excellent. Safe to spray pesticides and liquid compost.
insights.sprayWarning: High wind speeds detected. Postpone pesticide spraying to avoid drift.
insights.humidityHigh: High humidity detected. Watch out for fungal infections in vegetable crops.
insights.rainSoon: Heavy rain forecast within 24 hours. Postpone fertilizer broadcasting.
insights.normalConditions: Stable weather conditions. Good window for general weeding and bed maintenance.

irrigation.title: Smart Irrigation Planner
irrigation.warningLowMoisture: Low Soil Moisture: Plan full irrigation cycle. Mix Biochar to improve absorption.
irrigation.rainExpected: Rain Expected Soon: Hold irrigation today to prevent soil leaching.
irrigation.evapWarning: High Evaporation Rate: Water early in the morning or late evening to prevent loss.
irrigation.normalAdvice: Normal Moisture Level: Apply light watering to root zones. Maintain biochar coverage.

alerts.title: Active Weather Alerts
alerts.stormAlert: Thunderstorm Warning: Safe storage of harvested grains required.
alerts.windWarning: High Wind Warning: Secure nursery plastic covers and greenhouse sheets.
alerts.rainWarning: Flood Warning: Clear field drainage channels to prevent root rot.
alerts.heatWarning: Extreme Heat: Increase watering frequency to protect young saplings.
